faq.q: Do acreages in Maple Ridge have wells and septic?
faq.a: Many do. Ask for the well flow test and water quality results, and the septic filing and inspection records, before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I subdivide an acreage in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: It depends on the zoning, whether the land is in the Agricultural Land Reserve, servicing and the minimum lot size, and it needs municipal approval. Ask the municipality before you buy with a subdivision in mind.
